يستعطف (form X)

# يُسْتَعْطَفُ (yustaʕṭafu) /jus.taʕ.tˤa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# يَسْتَعْطِفَ (yastaʕṭifa) /jas.taʕ.tˤi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْ
